title: Blood Biomarkers Based Screening for HPV-driven OPC
official: SCREEN-HPV: A Study Evaluating a Blood Biomarker-based Screening for HPV-driven Oropharyngeal Carcinoma
summary: The objective of our study is to demonstrate that it is possible to detect and treat human papilloma virus (HPV)-related oropharyngeal cancers (OPC) early using simple blood tests. The success of this strategy will be evaluated by the number of participants positive for both HPV16-E6 serology and HPV circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) whose early management has allowed the detection of a cancerous lesion and/or whose HPV ctDNA results have normalized after surgical intervention. If this study is conclusive, it could pave the way for the implementation of a national screening strategy for HPV-related OPC.
conditions: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
criteria:
Inclusion criteria

For the selection phase:

1. Participants must have signed the selection written informed consent prior to any trial specific procedures. When the participant is physically unable to give their written consent, a trusted person of their choice, independent from the investigator or the sponsor, can confirm in writing the participant's consent.
2. Adult males ≥50 and ≤70 yo.
3. No previous history of HPV-driven cancer or head and neck , penis or anal canal cancer.
4. Participant consent to be contacted by a medical team from one of the investigational sites in case of HPV16-E6 or HPV ctDNA positivity for participation in the follow-up phase.
5. Participants must be affiliated to a Social Security System (or equivalent).
6. Participant consent to the use of their collected blood samples, as detailed in the protocol, for HPV16-E6 analysis and HPV ctDNA testing.

For the follow-up phase:

1. Participant must have signed the follow-up written informed consent prior to any trial specific procedures. When the participant is physically unable to give their written consent, a trusted person of their choice, independent from the investigator or the sponsor, can confirm in writing the participant's consent.
2. HPV16-E6 and/or HPV ctDNA positivity.
3. Participant consent to the use of their collected tumor specimen as well as blood samples as detailed in the protocol for tumor characterisation and HPV ctDNA testing.
4. Participant must be willing and able to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study including scheduled visits, treatment plan, laboratory tests and other study procedures.
5. Participant must be affiliated to a Social Security System (or equivalent).

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Previous prophylactic HPV vaccination.
2. Participants with uncontrolled severe medical condition that could limit compliance with study requirements during the planned follow-up period.
3. Participants unwilling or unable to comply with the medical follow-up required by the study because of geographic, familial, social, or psychological reasons.
4. Participants with any other disease or illness incompatible with the study obligations are not eligible.
5. Person deprived of their liberty or under protective custody or guardianship.
